tactics: have key : ∀ l (t : List.Mem a l), List.Mem.below (motive := motive) t ∧ motive l t := by intro l t; induction t with | head as => exact ⟨by constructor, F _ _ (by constructor)⟩ | tail b h ih => exact ⟨by constructor <;> first | exact ih.1 | exact ih.2, F _ _ (by constructor <;> first | exact ih.1 | exact ih.2)⟩

exact (List.Mem.rec (motive := fun l t => List.Mem.below (motive := motive) t ∧ motive l t) (fun as => ⟨by constructor, F _ _ (by constructor)⟩) (fun b h ih => ⟨by constructor <;> first | exact ih.1 | exact ih.2, F _ _ (by constructor <;> first | exact ih.1 | exact ih.2)⟩) t).2

exact (List.Mem.rec (motive := fun l t => List.Mem.below (motive := motive) t ∧ motive l t) (fun as => ⟨.head as, F _ _ (.head as)⟩) (fun b h ih => ⟨.tail b h ih.1 ih.2, F _ _ (.tail b h ih.1 ih.2)⟩) t).2
have key : ∀ l (t : List.Mem a l), List.Mem.below (motive := motive) t ∧ motive l t := by intro l t; induction t <;> constructor <;> (try apply F) <;> (try constructor) <;> simp_all
